blockingIssues.description: The farms-summary localization fix is incomplete because `app/(tabs)/farms.tsx` now calls `t('farms.summary.count')` and `t('farms.summary.area')`, but `src/i18n/locales/en.ts` still has no `farms.summary` block. Since English is both the active default locale and the fallback locale, the new summary line will render missing-key output for English users.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the locale-parity exception for redesign and fix work: when a task introduces or reroutes user-facing copy behind translation keys, workers may edit locale files and must update all supported locales together instead of treating `src/i18n/` as categorically off-limits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The prior failed feature `fix-core-screens-i18n-a11y-tokens` and this rerun `fix-core-screens-i18n-locales` both had to touch locale files to satisfy scrutiny, yet `.factory/skills/ui-worker/SKILL.md` and mission guidance still say not to modify i18n keys / translation files. This round still failed because only `hi.ts` and `mr.ts` received the new `farms.summary.*` keys while `en.ts` was left behind.
